decisions.reason: The niche naval lighting system likely meets specialized demand and its continued website presence suggests results are near aspiration, so management keeps it.
The general interior luminaire faces intense competition and its reduced website prominence hints at below-aspiration results, but slack and remaining uncertainty make a near-term drop less likely.
The differentiated microprismatic pendant luminaire is still actively promoted as a new release, indicating results above aspiration and a clear keep decision.
The marine searchlight serves a stable professional niche and its persistent website presence implies acceptable performance relative to aspirations.
